sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Purushottam Dixit, learned counsel for the applicants as well as Sri V.K.S. Parmar,
learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the material available on record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants in F.I.R./Case Crime No. 141 of 2020, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Vaidpura, District Etawah, with a prayer to enlarge them on anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Dadhiram And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, the applicants are stated to have caused loss to State Ex-chequer by producing fake bills regarding payment to various labourers of MNREGA.
5. Learned counsel for the applicants has stated that the applicants are maliciously being prosecuted in the present case due to ulterior motive and have the apprehension of their arrest.
The applicants have nothing to do with the said offence as alleged by the prosecution.

Learned counsel has next stated that later on, on inquiry conducted by the BDO, Jaswant Nagar, Etawah, it was found that Rs.
6,552/- regarding the labour charges to twenty-one labourers were inadvertently released and the same has been deposited back.

The applicants and co-accused person were granted anticipatory bail till submission of report u/s 173(2) Cr.P.C. or 45 days, whichever is earlier, vide order dated 25.3.2021, passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application u/s 438 Cr.P.C. No. 4517 of 2021.

6. In support of his submission, learned counsel has placed reliance upon the judgement of the Apex Court in Aman Preet Singh vs. C.B.I. through Director AIR 2021 SC 4154, wherein the Court has clearly held that if a person, who is an accused in a non-bailable/cognizable offence, was not taken into custody during the period of investigation, in such a case, it is appropriate that he may be released on bail as the circumstances of his having not been arrested during investigation or not being produced in custody is itself sufficient to entitle him to be released on bail.

entities.text: Aman Preet Singh vs. C.B.I. through Director AIR 2021 SC 4154
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicants to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against them.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicants have also been touched upon at length.
It is further submitted that the applicants have no criminal antecedents.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed, they will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.
8. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicants.

9. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and in view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98", the applicants are entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in this case.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 10. Without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.

entities.text: Dadhiram And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 12. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicants.

13. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicants shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.

(Justice Krishan Pahal) Order Date :- 16.12.2023 Shalini  Dadhiram And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104292469/
